name: Lightwell Demo — Block Critical CVEs (CVSS >= 9.0)
description: Blocks deployment of images containing vulnerabilities with CVSS score 9.0 or higher. Part of the Lightwell + ACS + TPA demo.
rationale: Critical CVEs represent the highest risk to production environments and must be remediated before deployment.
remediation: Use Lightwell Network remediated dependencies to resolve critical vulnerabilities without upgrading to new major versions.
